changelog:
Low-Level CPU Telemetry: Real-time per-core CPU load gauges, Mach thread profiling, Metal GPU identification, and Neural Engine (ANE) TOPS mapping.
• jedRAMChecker Enhancements: Live Mach VM statistics breakdown, plus accurate detection for 64-bit address space, paid Extended VA entitlements, and Increased Memory Limit caps.
• Security & UI Refinements: Decoupled jedOSSecuCheck profile pills with dedicated manual diagnostic triggers, plus universal Accent Color support across feature views.

This update is recommended for all users.
